correctness.rationale: Every graph and nerve simplex is reconstructed from the explicit finite definition. The 55 listed free-face pairs are checked against the live face poset, yielding a 2-complex with f=(11,46,46). Its star spanning tree gives one 0-cell, 36 1-cells and 46 2-cells. Exact signed boundary construction gives a 36x36 determinant +2 minor, full mod-3 rank 36 and mod-2 rank 35, forcing 35 unit Smith factors and one factor 2; kernel rank 10. All ranks and bounds are for the fully enumerated 11-vertex object; no extrapolation or unproved infinite claim.

value.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the canonical triangle-free four-chromatic Mycielski graph, motivating its metric nerves beyond the hypercube family. Its scale-two closed-neighborhood nerve exhibits genuine first integral 2-torsion even though the rational first Betti number is zero; this creates a natural concrete boundary to sphere-wedge phenomena and field-only graph-nerve homology examples. The graph, scale, and invariant are not chosen by arbitrary parameter slicing: scale two is the first closed-neighborhood transition, and integral torsion is invisible over characteristic-zero coefficients. The complete signed certificate is independently replayable with standard Python.
